name: maka
description: Language support for Maka: syntax highlighting (embedded Rust/C) plus a language server (diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, outline, completion, formatting).

maka.server.path.description: Path to the maka-lsp language server binary. Empty = use the server bundled in the extension, else `maka-lsp` on PATH. Set an absolute path (e.g. .../target/release/maka-lsp) to override with a dev build.

maka.server.enabled.description: Run the maka-lsp language server (diagnostics, hover, definition, outline, completion).
